title: Clara Wu Tsai, the Billionaire Who Wants Brooklyn to Win
summary: Clara Wu Tsai, a co-owner of the Liberty, is hoping the W.N.B.A. team pulls through tonight. She also has ambitions for the borough beyond more championships.
